meta.title: Programs
meta.description: Children's Quran class, new Muslim course, Japanese class, Open Mosque, school visits, weekly study circle, and youth programme at Al Muttaqin Cultural Center, Matsudo.

title: Learn, grow,
description: Regular classes and activities for children, new Muslims, families, neighbours, and schools. Most are free; registration helps us prepare a seat for you.

detail.registerDescription: We will reply within two working days with the next session and what to bring.
detail.closedDescription: No registration is needed for this program. Questions? Contact us and we will help.

1.title: Age 4 to 12
1.text: Children are grouped by age and reading level on the first day.

2.title: A parent or guardian registers
2.text: Please give a contact we can reach on Sunday mornings.

3.title: Bring an Iqra or Quran if you have one
3.text: We lend books to those who do not. There is no fee; infaq is welcome.

1.title: Open to everyone
1.text: You do not need to be Muslim or planning to become one. Curiosity is enough.

2.title: No prior knowledge
2.text: We start from the beginning in plain Japanese. Interpreters for English or Indonesian are available on request.

3.title: Free of charge
3.text: Materials are provided. You may join any session, with or without notice.

1.title: Any level
1.text: Beginners start with hiragana and daily phrases; intermediate learners practise reading forms and conversation.

2.title: Notebook and pen
2.text: Printed worksheets are provided. Please bring a notebook.

3.title: Free, by volunteers
3.text: Classes are taught by Japanese volunteers. Steady attendance is appreciated.

1.title: Walk-ins welcome
1.text: Individuals and families can simply come on the day. Groups of ten or more, please register.

2.title: Dress comfortably
2.text: No special clothing is required. Scarves are available to borrow for women who would like to enter the prayer hall.

3.title: Plan about 90 minutes
3.text: Tour, prayer demonstration, Q&A, and halal snacks. Come and go as you like.

1.title: Request two weeks ahead
1.text: Tell us the date, the number of visitors, the age group, and the purpose of the visit.

2.title: Up to 40 visitors per session
2.text: Larger groups can be split into two sessions on the same day.

3.title: Weekdays, 10:00 to 16:00
3.text: Visits are scheduled around the prayer times so you can observe a congregational prayer.

1.title: Everyone is welcome
1.text: No registration. Arrive before Maghrib to pray together, then stay for the talk.

2.title: Three languages in rotation
2.text: Check the agenda for this week's language. Summaries are shared in the WhatsApp group.

3.title: Recordings on YouTube
3.text: If you miss a session, watch it later in the Lectures section.

1.title: Age 13 to 22
1.text: Junior high, high school, and university students, as well as young workers.

2.title: Register once
2.text: Parents of participants under 18 are asked to register on their behalf.

3.title: Join the group chat
3.text: Activities and outings are announced in the youth WhatsApp group.

muallaf.title: Walking with you,
muallaf.description: For anyone curious about Islam or who has recently embraced it, we offer company rather than pressure.

1.title: A mentor for each person
1.text: You are paired with one companion who answers questions, prays beside you, and stays in touch between sessions.

2.title: Materials in Japanese
2.text: Short, clear handouts in Japanese, with English and Indonesian available.

3.title: The shahada, when you are ready
3.text: If and when you decide to become Muslim, the declaration takes a minute. We can arrange witnesses and a certificate.

4.title: The steps after
4.text: Learning to pray, fasting for the first time, talking with family, and finding halal food: your mentor stays with you.

visits.title: Our doors
visits.description: Neighbours, schools, municipalities, and companies are welcome to see the mosque and meet the community.

1.title: Send a request
1.text: Use the form on the program page or WhatsApp. Tell us the date, the group size, and what you would like to learn.

2.title: Duration
2.text: Open Mosque runs 13:00 to 16:00; school visits take 60 to 90 minutes, including Q&A.

3.title: Capacity
3.text: Up to 40 visitors per session. Larger groups are split into two sessions.

4.title: Visiting etiquette
4.text: Shoes off at the prayer hall, comfortable clothing, and ask before taking photos of people. Scarves can be borrowed.

1.a: All programs are free. Voluntary infaq helps cover materials and snacks.

2.a: Yes. Most programs run in cycles and sessions stand on their own. Just register and come.

3.a: It depends on the program; see the language badges. Volunteers can interpret in Japanese, English, and Indonesian.

cta.title: Not sure which program fits?
cta.body: Send us a message and we will suggest the right class or visit for you or your family.

whatsapp.title: Program registration - Al Muttaqin
whatsapp.greeting: Assalamu'alaikum, I would like to ask about programs at Al Muttaqin.

form.participantHint: Fill in only if you are registering someone else.
form.contactHint: We will use this only to confirm your registration.
form.notesPlaceholder: Questions, availability, or anything we should know.

success.title: Registration received
success.body: Thank you. We will contact you about {program} within two working days.

fallback.title: One more step
fallback.body: Online storage is not active yet. Tap the button to send your registration to us on WhatsApp; the message is ready.

validation.age: Please enter the participant's age (1 to 120).
